about: The /boss onboarding form, the one source for the skill (AskUserQuestion: at most 4 questions per call, 4 options each, Other always offered) and bin/boss-init (--questions, --answers). `bosskit.py onboard questions` adds each question's current value and packs the ones to ask into calls; `bosskit.py onboard apply <answers.json>` turns the answers into config and BOSS.md changes. Per question: id (the answers file's key), key (the dotted config key it sets; a list sets each), level (where its value lands unless a level is named), derive (a path into `bosskit.py detect`: when it gives a value, the question is not asked), free (asked as a plain question, no options), options [{label, value, description}] (value "$default" is the kit default; an answer is a label, a value or Other text, which is JSON when it parses), and multiSelect questions sharing a key add up.

questions.question: What should workers post on the PR? Check any, all or none. To choose none, leave every box unchecked, or pick Other and type none.

options.label: Status comment
options.description: One short plain-English done or blocked note, ending with the hidden marker the watcher reads

options.label: Proof links
options.description: The pages and demo links, in that status note

options.label: Demo video
options.description: The recorded demo, attached to the PR

options.label: Hidden marker only
options.description: Instead of the status note: an otherwise empty comment holding only the hidden done marker

questions.question: And these? Check any, all or none. To choose none, leave every box unchecked, or pick Other and type none.

options.label: Review replies
options.description: Workers reply on the PR's review threads themselves

options.label: Verify note
options.description: The boss posts what it verified when it marks the PR ready

fixed: Merging: the boss never merges, closes a PR or pushes to the base branch without your OK in the conversation. That is fixed, not a setting.

expectations.heading: ## Expectations
expectations.question: What are your expectations of me as the boss of your project?

options.label: Ship fast
options.value: Ship fast: small PRs, merged often.
options.description: Speed first, within the hard rules

options.label: Be careful
options.value: Be careful: verify everything twice, ask when unsure.
options.description: Safety first

options.label: Keep me informed
options.value: Keep me informed: a short report at every change.
options.description: Visibility first

expectations.note: Free text: pick Other and write it in your own words (or pick any and add to them). It is saved to the project's BOSS.md under ## Expectations, which every later boss session loads.

closing: I'm a mere boss but you are the god. I hope to please you and get things done. Always let me know how I can be better.
